items.anchor:
Does unmodified full BFGS converge
locally
items.note: Open problem 1. C2StronglyConvexLocalFailure is the failure alternative (a finite maximum of uniformly strongly convex C^2 branches with starts tending to the minimizer, H_0 = I, a fixed pair and actual runs of the specified search that do not converge to it); its negation for every such F is the every-start local convergence asked about. By Corollary art:planar-max, a planar instance must violate active-gradient nondegeneracy. Neither alternative is proved.

resolved_discrepancies.description: The identity G(t(-1,16)) = -t holds only for t >= 0, as failure.tex:201 states ("Hence G(tw)=-t for t>=0"). Without the range it is false: at t = -1, G(1,-16) >= c_o - 16 d_o > 16 > 1 = -t (Lean counterexample). Only t >= 0 is needed for "unbounded below".
